accelerator_requirement: Enough measured free device and host memory for the existing unquantized float32/bfloat16 Qwen/PEFT backend. 24 GB is only a planning preference; no minimum training VRAM is established.
measurement_plan: On an already authorized compatible accelerator, measure loading and a bounded real-data step before the full cohort; approve the fixed recipe and measured cost allocation first.
storage_request: An approved existing read-only model mount avoids a new model copy; otherwise authorize at least the calculated base/factor lower bound plus a measured data/output/temp allowance in a resolved plan.
training_recipe: Unresolved pending real data and pilot review: fixed record IDs/counts, task seeds, steps, learning rate, alpha/dropout, token lengths and specialist-quality admission. Existing backend is batch-one AdamW; do not use the software fixture recipe.
